name: appbyahmad
description: Lets hosting platforms (Railway, Render, Koyeb...) build and start the server from the repository root with no extra settings. The build also exports the Elauxi web app, served at the site root.

scripts.build: npm --prefix server ci --include=dev && npm --prefix server run build && npm run build:web
scripts.build:web: npm --prefix mobile ci && cd mobile && EXPO_PUBLIC_SAME_ORIGIN=1 npx expo export --platform web --output-dir ../server/web
